# d-pill

> A design skill for agents that build interfaces. d-pill commits one visual direction, sets type and color as roles, and passes a critique gate before the work is called done. The critique has a machine half now: rules as data, a zero-dependency checker, an MCP server, and a GitHub Action. MIT, offline, no dependencies.

The procedure is SKILL.md. The knowledge is references/. The values are references/tokens.json, verified against references/base.css by scripts/check-tokens.py. The gate is scripts/critique.py, its registry references/rules.json.

Install with `git clone https://github.com/srivtx/d-pill.git ~/.grok/skills/d-pill`, or `npx skills add srivtx/d-pill`, or Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add srivtx/d-pill`, then `/plugin install d-pill@d-pill`.

## SKILL.md

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): procedure, laws, the routing table — what to read for which job.

- [tokens.json](references/tokens.json): the machine export of base.css, verified.
- [rules.json](references/rules.json): the machine rule registry — the gate's rules as data.
- [layout.md](references/layout.md): primitives, density, breakpoints.

- [reading.md](references/reading.md): the sources behind the judgments.

## scripts

- [critique.py](scripts/critique.py): the machine gate. Zero dependencies. Findings as file:line:col [rule] severity. Exit 0 clean, 2 findings, 1 broken invocation.
- [mcp-server.py](scripts/mcp-server.py): d-pill over MCP (stdio, JSON-RPC 2.0, standard library only). Tools: critique, list_rules, token.
- [check-tokens.py](scripts/check-tokens.py): verifies tokens.json against base.css.
- [contrast.py](scripts/contrast.py): contrast for a custom OKLCH pair.

## docs

- [docs/index.html](docs/index.html): the demo page. It passes its own gate, in CI, on every push.
